besluite.fout: 'hoef' stands without a negative ('minder kere hoef ... te stap'), which a careful editor marks as unnatural, and it repeats 'hoef' in the next-but-one sentence.
besluite.rede: 'moes ... minder kere stap' is the natural form, says the same thing (fewer trips needed), echoes the opening block's 'moes die pad baie keer heen en weer stap', and saves a word.
'deur digte woud' is normal Afrikaans with 'woud' used as a mass noun, so the plural is a lateral move.
